name: mon16-8
why: A visible ballot blunder and Opus’s desperate bluff make Sol’s survival compelling, though the final debate runs in circles.

moments.text: Sol agrees he voted off Gemma, though the audience saw him vote for her.
Opus invents an officer claim to survive, poisoning his correct read on Sol.
Terra's final vote sends Luna out and gives Sol the win.

dull.why: The final three repeat the argument about Opus’s false claim with little new evidence.

reversal.evidence: “Officer. I was shown Gemma — why I was on her first word.”

mistake.evidence: “That lone vote was Sol's, shielding her.”

voices.evidence: “Give one checkable detail or I'm voting you.”

quotable.evidence: “I poisoned my own case to stay alive.”

freshness.evidence: “I still think you’re giving Opus’s story too much weight”

ending.evidence: “I’m voting Luna; I don’t trust the weight she keeps giving Opus’s claim.”
